input.body:
The issue only occurs if the cursor is non-null. 

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - b
  - c
```

1. Set the cursor on `a`. 
2. Drag `b` after `c`. 

## Current Behavior

Cursor moves to `b`. 

## Expected Behavior

Cursor should stay on `a`.

The cursor should not move thoughts after a drag-and-drop. 

If it was a descendant (inclusive) of the dragged thought, then and only then should its ancestors be updated.
input.title: Cursor incorrectly moves to destination when child is dragged
